justification: All three headline claims are reproduced by the minimal d-wave model. C1: BZ-averaged splitting=0 and net moment=0 while local max split=2.4 (4t_AM) confirms compensated-yet-spin-split dichotomy. C2: C4+spin-flip residual=0 vs translation residual=2.4 confirms the symmetry identification rule exactly. C3: nodal lines at kx=±ky, 4 sign changes, antinode amplitude 2.4, BZ-integrated to zero confirms d-wave structure. Material-specific DFT results are out of scope but the conceptual/symmetry claims central to the paper are fully reproduced.
caveats: No DFT band structures for real materials (RuO2, Mn5Si3, etc.) were computed; only the representative tight-binding d-wave model was validated. Absolute energy scales are model-normalized, not material-specific.
